sonnet.problem: The question says Asaph 'sums them all up as ___ of war.' Verse 3 lists 'weapons of war' as one more item after the flaming arrows, shield and sword. It does not say it sums up the others, so the card adds a connection the text doesn't state.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

sonnet.problem: The card asks what 'sleep their last sleep' means and marks 'They have lost their lives' as the only right answer. That treats the picture as having one fixed meaning, which the passage doesn't state.
sonnet.rule: This includes what a picture means. He retells the picture as the text gives it and says what it stands for only when the passage says so.

sonnet.problem: The wrong answer 'weapons' was already the right answer on Stop 1 card 6, so an answer shown earlier is reused on a later card.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
